title.justification: The title clearly states the main focus of the paper, which is optimizing dynamic programming solvers for Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) through improved cache efficiency.

extractions.description: This paper focuses on improving the computational efficiency of Markov Decision Process (MDP) solvers by leveraging hardware features, particularly cache memory. Two state-reordering techniques, eTVI and eiTVI, are proposed to enhance the Topological Value Iteration (TVI) algorithm. These techniques aim to improve cache performance through strategic memory organization, resulting in faster MDP solving, especially in instances with large state spaces.
